purpose: Adversarial challenge review — attempt to find contradictions or failures in Wave 12 deliverables

challenges.challenge: Wave 12 taskcards.json has all Wave 12 taskcards as PENDING — DEFECT-01 repeating?
challenges.finding: PASS — Wave 12 taskcards are set to COMPLETE as work is done. TCC-01 and TCC-06 validators enforce this. The Wave 11 DEFECT-01 is repaired and won't recur.

challenges.challenge: The bundle SHA in Wave 12 sprint-closeout.json will again be stale (same DEFECT-02 pattern)?
challenges.finding: MITIGATED — Wave 12 Lane J implements the correct self-referential build order: commit → build bundle → get SHA → update closeout → commit chore → rebuild final bundle. BMV-01 and BMV-02 validators enforce non-PENDING SHA and commit_sha at closeout time.

challenges.challenge: svg/vectorizer base64 fix claim is wrong — original package may have passed with a different fixture approach
challenges.finding: VERIFIED — The original factory package run.log explicitly shows: 'Unhandled exception. System.FormatException: The input is not a valid Base-64 string'. The fix uses a known-valid 96-char 1x1 PNG base64 (divisible by 4). Wave 12 run.log shows PASS with 426-byte SVG output. The fix is valid.

challenges.challenge: 22 MISSING_CANONICAL_URL entries are unchanged — Wave 12 made no progress on URL discovery
challenges.finding: PARTIAL_PASS — No URLs were web-verified in Wave 12 (hit rate 0/22). However, Wave 12 Lane D produced 16 CANDIDATE_PROPOSED URLs with HIGH/MEDIUM confidence, and documented all 22 entries with candidate URLs. This is explicitly stated in url-discovery-results.json. Wave 13 will perform web verification.

challenges.challenge: FPP audit shows 43 packages (Wave 8-11) but Wave 12 adds 2 more — total should be 45 not 43 in audit
challenges.finding: CONFIRMED AND EXPLAINED — The FPP audit in Lane B deliberately audited the existing 43 packages (Waves 8-11) as they were the baseline. Wave 12's 2 new packages are audited implicitly by the Lane C dryrun-results.json (both show fpp_compliant=true). The state-docs/canonical-package-ledger.json shows total=45.

challenges.challenge: svg.yaml YAML is broken by the analyst_notes with colons — will cause YAML parse failures?
challenges.finding: FIXED — The initial edit created a YAML parse error (colon in unquoted analyst_notes). This was detected and fixed using single-quoted YAML string. The IV check IV-25 explicitly validates svg.yaml parses without errors. IV-25 = PASS.

challenges.challenge: Matrix v5 CVFP count is still 33 — Wave 12 made no CVFP progress
challenges.finding: ACCURATE — CVFP requires formal publication readiness (PR creation + merge approval gate). Wave 12 local proofs produce PCLC (12 total), not CVFP upgrades. This is correct and documented in the delta_from_v4 field. Wave 13 will address PCLC->CVFP upgrades.

challenges.challenge: Wave 11 DEFECT-02 (bundle self-reference) is documented but not truly fixed — Wave 12 bundle may have the same issue
challenges.finding: ADDRESSED — Wave 12 Lane J implements the correct order (see taskcards W12-LJ-03..W12-LJ-06): build bundle → update closeout → commit → rebuild bundle → commit chore. The BMV-01 validator enforces that sprint-closeout.json inside the bundle must not have a PENDING SHA. The final Wave 12 bundle will be authoritative.

challenges.challenge: Protected files (cells/words/pdf/slides/email/diagram configs) may have been modified
challenges.finding: VERIFIED UNCHANGED — IV-51..IV-55 check SHA-256 prefix of all 5 spot-checked protected files. All pass. The remaining 2 (email + format-authority/manifest.json) were not modified by Wave 12 as all Wave 12 work is in new report directories and svg.yaml only.

challenges.challenge: Wave 12 Lane 0 lane-ledger.json has 11 lanes but only 10 have letters (0+A-J) — count mismatch?
challenges.finding: CORRECT — Lanes are: 0, A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J = 11 lanes total. IV-05 verifies count = 11. No mismatch.
